module_summary: AXI-stream register slice; with REG_TYPE=2 a skid buffer of output registers plus a temp register keeps full throughput while registering tready.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input beat valid, loaded into output or temp valid registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload stored to output or temp data register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready steering store decisions and early input ready.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload from output data register.

anchors.name: genblk1.temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid register holding input beat when output is stalled.

anchors.name: genblk1.temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid register occupied flag; gates early ready and temp-to-output move.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axis_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads input beat directly into output registers.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axis_input_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads input beat into temp skid registers.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp skid registers into output registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Representative input sideband (tlast) registered alongside data.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Representative output sideband from tlast register.

groups.name: Skid control
groups.description: Decides where each beat is stored and when temp drains to output.

groups.name: Temp skid buffer
groups.description: Temp data and sideband registers absorbing one stalled beat.

groups.name: Output register
groups.description: Output data/sideband registers and valid driving master interface.
